title: Handoff card v1
description: Compact, agent-agnostic brief for Muse or any generic worker. Keep it small; point at files instead of pasting transcripts.

goal.description: The outcome to produce, in one short paragraph.

constraints.description: Hard limits: paths, permissions, budget, deadline, account pinning, forbidden side effects.

command.description: Optional command that must exit 0 on the integrated revision.

evidence.description: What a reviewer should see if there is no single command.

inputs.description: Optional paths the worker may read, relative to the worktree.

result_path.description: Where the worker should write the compact result envelope.
